name: GitLab complete TestOps alias owner (CHAOS-3356)
$limitation: This plan pins the combined GitLab TestOps claim boundary, alias selection and caps, fractional provider-query precision, Python's single-page artifact-discovery boundary, explicit unauthenticated artifact redirect, six-effect projection, provider binding, estimator parity, canonical actual-usage observations and persistence, mutually-exclusive gates, route readiness, production worker construction, and FINAL collision recovery. Live row/selection oracles cover every persisted field, physical request counts, and the active Python producer. Existing generalized TestOps integration tests cover atomic per-table batches and tenant isolation. This plan does not claim failed-attempt actual-usage persistence, live credentialed GitLab traffic, a cross-table ClickHouse transaction, deployment activation, scheduler activation, schema redesign, or migration 0066.
